newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, fuel barge bids nudge up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, fuel barge bids nudge up.

text.p: NWE oil products opened steady on a thin Tuesday morning, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were unchanged as IPE June gas oil futures opened flat. Offers remained at around IPE June +$1 fob Rotterdam.

High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $85.50 and $86 fob Rotterdam, little changed from levels seen late on Monday. Traders said the only real change was that bids were firmer than at Monday's close -- at $85.
